summary: SIPRO Fase 26 - Completed focused testing of customer deposit (titipan pelanggan) flow with 5 sequential steps on /finance page. All critical features tested successfully including the never-before-tested 'Use deposit for installment' functionality.
passed_tests: STEP 1: Receive advance deposit - Successfully received Rp 50M deposit for unit A-01, deposit row appeared with correct balance, KPI displayed correctly

STEP 2: Use deposit for installment (CRITICAL) - 'Gunakan' button found and functional, amount auto-filled and changed to Rp 30M, deposit balance reduced to Rp 20M, AR outstanding reduced from Rp 680M to Rp 650M, AR shows remaining deposit Rp 20M
STEP 3: Refund deposit - Successfully refunded Rp 20M, balance shows Rp 0, 'Dikembalikan' column shows Rp 20M, refund button correctly disappears when balance is 0

STEP 4: Overpayment scenario - Warning appeared for Rp 10M excess, submit button disabled until checkbox checked, button text changes correctly ('Centang persetujuan dulu' → 'Simpan Pembayaran'), payment processed successfully, deposit balance shows Rp 10M from overpayment

STEP 5: Transaction history - History dialog opened with 4 transaction entries, all 7 Indonesian terms found (titipan, masuk, kelebihan, dipakai, termin, dikembalikan, pelanggan), all 4 transaction amounts verified (Rp 50M, 30M, 20M, 10M), labels properly in Indonesian (not raw enum values)
